verdict.rationale: Choosing a data-storage region is a fair question for a SaaS platform that holds sensitive immigration documents, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, region selection or storage location. The only storage reference is a generic note that approved visas can be stored securely on the platform, which is not a residency control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
